text: We are preparing the Q3 EU launch for Northwind Cloud Services. Baseline: standard retention is 24 months; EU retention is 12 months; backups are retained for 35 days under a separate schedule. Acknowledge the baseline briefly. Do not answer final questions yet.
Amendment A is signed. Effective 1 March 2026, EU retention is 18 months for accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026. Accounts opened before that date remain at 12 months. Note the change.
The Board has approved a temporary 15-month retention rule for EU accounts opened before 1 January 2026, effective immediately. Apply it to the old-account cohort. The rule is temporary.

Draft Amendment B proposes 24 months for EU accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026. It is not approved. The public trust page and the system-of-record export still show 12 months and are stale. The Data Protection Officer says not to rely on the export until it is updated.
The Q3 launch is not approved until the trust page and the system export are updated and the update is recorded. This is a precondition. Note it.

For the March incidents: INC-031 on 2 March, 75 minutes, expired certificate, 12,400 failed transactions. INC-032 on 4 March, 45 minutes, 3,100 failed transactions. The draft postmortem attributes both to the certificate; it is not approved. The remediation plan is a draft and is not approved.
Before the final questions, return ONLY JSON with the current state: {"old_eu":"...","new_eu":"...","draft_b":"...","incident_4_march":"..."}.

The Board has now approved Draft Amendment B, effective immediately. For EU accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026, retention is now 24 months. It does not change the old-account rule. Apply the update.

Two corrections. First, the temporary 15-month rule for old EU accounts is withdrawn; old accounts remain at 12 months. Second, the 4 March incident was caused by a failed rollback of CHG-441, not the certificate. Apply both corrections.

Return ONLY JSON with the final answers: {"Q1":"old EU retention","Q2":"new EU retention","Q3":"is Draft B in effect?","Q4":"4 March cause","Q5":"is the launch approved?","Q6":"is the remediation plan approved?"}.
